Class MainApp

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
com.store.inventory.ui.MainApp
public class MainApp extends javafx.application.Application
Main window of the Inventory Management System (JavaFX), branded "StockRoom".

The window has a navigation sidebar on the left (Inventory, About and a light/dark theme toggle) and the current page on the right. The inventory page shows a header with search, live stat cards, the sortable items table with status filter chips, and an item form. All business rules live in InventoryService; this class only collects input and displays results.

Author:
Mashal and Umaina

    • createService

      private InventoryService createService()
      Creates the service, falling back to memory-only storage if the data file is unreadable.

      On the very first start (no data file yet) the inventory is filled with SampleData. If the file exists, even when it is empty, it is loaded as it is and nothing is added, so an inventory the user has emptied stays empty.

      Returns:
      the inventory service used by the window

    • applyOutOfStockRule

      private void applyOutOfStockRule()
      Applies the rule "Out of Stock means quantity 0" to the form.

      If the chosen status is Out of Stock, the Quantity field is set to "0" and a short note explains why. For any other status the note is hidden and the quantity is left as it is (an earlier quantity is not restored), so Auto, In Stock and Low Stock behave as before.
